snippet.title: The Rings of Powder - Gameplay (  Custom Game )
snippet.description:
"The Rings of Powder" gameplay with settings for 'Challenging' mode.

You can reduce the number of enemies and increase the spawn cycle to make the game calmer and more relaxing.

Some tips on how to start the game have been added.

Gra dostępna na Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2188570/The_Rings_of_Powder/
